title: Tally sheets.
bodyText: The tally sheets used in counting the ballots cast shall be marked and handled in a secure fashion prescribed in rules and regulations promulgated by the chief election officer in accordance with chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §16-29  Tally sheets.  The tally sheets used in counting the ballots cast shall be marked and handled in a secure fashion prescribed in rules and regulations promulgated by the chief election officer in accordance with chapter 91. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2]
